abi.event: ReserveDataUpdated(address indexed reserve,uint256 liquidityRate,uint256 stableBorrowRate,uint256 variableBorrowRate,uint256 liquidityIndex,uint256 variableBorrowIndex)

daily_series_rule.daily_observation: For each UTC date, use the final valid USDC ReserveDataUpdated event at or before 23:59:59 UTC.
daily_series_rule.missing_day: After the first valid historical observation, carry forward the most recent prior valid variableBorrowRate.
daily_series_rule.pre_first_observation: No backfill before the first valid Aave V3 USDC observation; these dates are structurally unavailable and excluded before any BTC outcome is opened.
daily_series_rule.predictor_later: Arithmetic change raw_rate_t - raw_rate_t_minus_1; exact positive scaling allowed only for numerical conditioning.

retained_output: raw variableBorrowRate RAY integer as decimal string
whether date had a new on-chain event
source event block/timestamp/logIndex for event days
post_pass_rule: PASS authorizes only freezing/executing the original predeclared 2023-2024 regression Discovery under separate explicit user authorization. It does not authorize 2025.
